title: [PLACEHOLDER] The Ethics of Disclosure
prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] A security researcher discovers a critical zero-day vulnerability in a widely used banking application while conducting authorised research on a different system. They were NOT given permission to test the banking app. What should they do?
context: [PLACEHOLDER] This scenario represents a common ethical dilemma in security research: the boundary between authorised and unauthorised testing, and the obligations around responsible disclosure.
guideQuestions: [PLACEHOLDER] Does the researcher have any legal obligation to report the vulnerability?
[PLACEHOLDER] What are the risks of reporting directly to the company vs. through a coordinated disclosure process?
[PLACEHOLDER] How does this differ from discovering the vulnerability during an authorised engagement?
[PLACEHOLDER] What would you do in this situation, and why?
